segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Hi, we're the Chartitable team. This is Chartitable, as in chart-it-able. If your donation does good, you should be able to chart it.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I give twenty five dollars to a small food pantry and feel great. A month later: same photo, same Donate Now button. Where did my money go? Did it buy a pizza for the intern? Black hole.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: It's not just me. Less than half of donors ever give again, forty three percent. Small pantries have no fundraising staff to write back, so donors quietly leave.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Chartitable is donor retention in one platform. Donors see their impact on the charity's own website. Charities get a dashboard showing who to thank and who's gone quiet. Claude writes the stories.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Okay. Same donation, now with Chartitable.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: A stranger sees the normal site. I give twenty five dollars, and the site knows I just gave.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: A week later, I get a note.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: The page rearranged around me: what the pantry did, and my share. All from one line of script on the charity's site.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now staff post eighty meals. I don't reload anything. In a few seconds the page shows it, and my share moves.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now the charity's side. One view shows who needs a thank-you, who's gone quiet, what was spent, and cost per meal. One click marks a donor thanked.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Before: a page that never changes. After: a page that shows what happened, and what to do next.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Donors stay when they can see the impact, and charities can reach out before they leave. Chartitable: donor retention you can chart. Thank you. Please clap. Please fund us.
